subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customers, Get ready for our exclusive summer sale event! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected items including swimwear, sandals, and sunglasses. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer to update your summer wardrobe with the latest trends. Visit our store or shop online to grab the hottest deals before they're gone. Hurry, the sale ends on July 31st! Happy shopping!
